test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who physically attacks another
solution:
The correct answer is **Assailant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Assailant'**(noun) means a person who assaults another person in a violent manner.

 
 
• *Example- The police will ask you to describe your **assailant.***
 
 
 
• Synonym of **Assailant**- **Attacker**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 

 The word **'Convict'** (noun) means one who has found guilty of a crime and put to prison.

 
 
• *​Example- The **convict** made repeated futile attempts to break out of jail.*
 
 
 
• **'Convict'** as a verb means proclaiming someone guilty of a crime by jury or court conviction.

 
 
• *Example- The old man was **convicted** and sentenced to death.*
 
 
 
• The word '**Scoundrel'** (noun) means a mean, immoral person, especially a male.
 
 
• *Example- The police promised to find the **scoundrel** who robbed my money.*
 
 
 
• Culprit (noun) means someone who has been guilty of an offence or of doing something inappropriate.
 
 
• *Example- She identified him as the main **culprit***.
